// buildCommand: Emits to a REPO-ROOT dist rather than apps/web/dist. A build that wrote apps/web/dist failed with 'No Output Directory named "dist" found after the Build completed' -- Vercel looked for dist at the root and did not apply outputDirectory: apps/web/dist. Building to the root means the vite framework preset's default and the value below name the same folder, so it no longer matters which one Vercel honours.
// rewrites: main.tsx routes on window.location.pathname with no router, so /decks, /play and /match/<id> are real URLs a player can open or reload. assets/ is excluded so a missing bundle stays a 404 instead of silently returning index.html as JavaScript.
